chainNotes.title: Robinhood Chain publishes no L2 sequencer-uptime feed, yet its docs require checking one
chainNotes.statement: Robinhood's oracle documentation instructs callers to "verify the sequencer is up before trusting a price" because during a sequencer outage feeds can go stale. No such feed could be found: the Robinhood Chain Chainlink reference-data directory contains 57 feeds and none is a sequencer-uptime feed, and chain 4663 does not appear on Chainlink's L2 Sequencer Uptime Feeds page, which lists Arbitrum, Base, Celo, Mantle, MegaETH, Metis, OP, Scroll, Soneium, X Layer and ZKsync. The recommended control therefore cannot be performed on this chain today. Stated as "not found in the published directories" rather than "does not exist".

chainNotes.title: 160 of 195 scanned Stock Tokens have no Chainlink price feed
chainNotes.statement: The Robinhood Chain Chainlink reference-data directory publishes 57 feeds, of which 35 are 24/5 equity feeds. 160 of the 195 Stock Tokens scanned have no feed entry, so they cannot be priced on-chain at all and any valuation must come from an off-chain source — which reintroduces the cross-surface mixing hazard. 21 of them also carry a uiMultiplier() other than 1.0, where an off-chain SHARE price differs from token value by that multiplier: CRM (1.0011x), CRWD (4.0000x), AVGO (1.0013x), CCL (1.0215x), PR (1.0045x), and 16 more.

findings.subject: CRM (0xd95B44124e475743a7589e68F3D74008A5536D44)
findings.title: CRM: balanceOf() is 1.001148323x away from share-equivalents
findings.statement: CRM reports uiMultiplier() = 1001148322800714293 (1.001148323). Under ERC-8056 a corporate action moves this multiplier rather than balances, so balanceOf() returns tokens, not share-equivalents. Share-equivalents = balance * uiMultiplier() / 1e18. Any surface presenting balanceOf() as a share count understates it by 0.1147% (the true count is 1.0011x the raw balance). Token value computed as balance * Chainlink feed price is unaffected, because the feed is already multiplier-adjusted.

impact.note: totalSupply raw 302.6430 tokens vs 302.9906 share-equivalents (delta 0.3475). Presenting the raw balance as a share count understates by 0.1147%; equivalently the true count is 1.0011x the raw.

findings.subject: SPY (0x117cc2133c37B721F49dE2A7a74833232B3B4C0C)
findings.title: SPY: off-chain share price and on-chain token price differ by 0.172%
findings.statement: The Chainlink feed returns a multiplier-adjusted TOKEN price (773.0897), while Robinhood's REST /prices endpoint returns the RAW UNDERLYING share price (mid 772.9550). These are different quantities related by uiMultiplier(): underlying x 1.001717991 = 774.2829 (residual -0.154%, attributable to bid/ask spread and quote timing). Valuing balanceOf() with an off-chain share price, or computing a premium/discount between an on-chain token price and an off-chain share price, produces a phantom error of 0.172%.

impact.note: feed 773.0897 vs underlying-mid 772.9550 x multiplier 1.001717991 = 774.2829

offChainSources.describes: underlying share bid/ask used for the mid 772.9550 (not multiplier-adjusted)

Under ERC-8056 a corporate action moves this multiplier rather than balances, so balanceOf() returns tokens, not share-equivalents. Share-equivalents = balance * uiMultiplier() / 1e18. Any surface presenting balanceOf() as a share count understates it by 0.1038% (the true count is 1.0010x the raw balance). Token value computed as balance * Chainlink feed price is unaffected, because the feed is already multiplier-adjusted.

impact.note: totalSupply raw 231.0417 tokens vs 231.2819 share-equivalents (delta 0.2402). Presenting the raw balance as a share count understates by 0.1038%; equivalently the true count is 1.0010x the raw.

findings.subject: ORCL (0xb0992820E760d836549ba69BC7598b4af75dEE03)
findings.title: ORCL: off-chain share price and on-chain token price differ by 0.221%
findings.statement: The Chainlink feed returns a multiplier-adjusted TOKEN price (149.0284), while Robinhood's REST /prices endpoint returns the RAW UNDERLYING share price (mid 148.5300). These are different quantities related by uiMultiplier(): underlying x 1.002210915 = 148.8584 (residual 0.114%, attributable to bid/ask spread and quote timing). Valuing balanceOf() with an off-chain share price, or computing a premium/discount between an on-chain token price and an off-chain share price, produces a phantom error of 0.221%.

impact.note: feed 149.0284 vs underlying-mid 148.5300 x multiplier 1.002210915 = 148.8584

offChainSources.describes: underlying share bid/ask used for the mid 148.5300 (not multiplier-adjusted)
